criteria.criterion: docs/conventions/owner-style.md exists and contains the owner's style paragraph verbatim, including 'Show me with big pictures and little words without witholding key details' and 'dont use weird metaphors'.
criteria.evidence: The diff creates docs/conventions/owner-style.md. Line 5 quotes: "Show me with big pictures and little words without witholding key details. dont use weird metaphors." Both required phrases are there, with the owner's spelling kept. No other copy of the paragraph is in the snapshot, so I could compare it only against the phrases the criterion quotes.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing the owner decision briefs page.
criteria.evidence: CHANGELOG.md has a new '### Added' entry under [Unreleased]. It describes decisions.html, which fields a brief uses, the role-limit recommendation, the refusals, the page shown when there is no records branch, and that no new format or dependency is added.

criteria.criterion: Grep of the diff shows xtask reads WorkItem proposals and role records through athena-data (check_record_file/AnyRecord) and introduces no new file format and no new dependency.
criteria.evidence: decisions.rs imports `AnyRecord, ..., WorkItem, WorkItemKind, check_record_file` from athena_data::records, and `Ladder, RoleDefinition, may_change` from athena_data::roles. read() runs check_record_file on each blob and matches AnyRecord::WorkItem, AnyRecord::WorkDecision and AnyRecord::Role. The diff stat shows that xtask/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are unchanged. xtask already depends on athena-data and athena-git. No schema or format is added.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test builds briefs from two fixture proposals with different title, rung, source and evidence and asserts the briefs differ, with no fixed cost, risk or 'Approve'.
criteria.evidence: The test briefs_from_different_proposals_differ_and_carry_no_fixed_cost_risk_or_approve passes. Its fixtures differ in title, rung and evidence, and it asserts the briefs differ and contain no Approve, cost or risk. But both fixtures get the same source: item() sets `source: Reference::path("docs/design/x.md")` for every proposal. The criterion asks for fixtures with different sources, and nothing shows that the source line comes from the proposal.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: with role fixtures, one proposal within the role's limit and one above it at the same rung produce exact, different recommendation lines; the in-limit one does not say 'Decide yourself', and a proposal with an unrecorded role says the role is not recorded.
criteria.evidence: the_recommendation_follows_the_limit_in_the_role_records passes. At rung defaults-conventions, steward (v2, limit defaults-conventions) and reader (limit implementation) get exact, different lines; the within-limit line does not contain 'Decide yourself'. The test also asserts the exact 'The nobody role is not recorded...' line and the top-two line. Steward v1 has the looser limit implementation, so the test also confirms the newest version is used.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test asserts every record link in the briefs begins with the Athena GitHub base (ATHENA_URL) and contains the records tip sha, and no href is relative.
criteria.evidence: every_record_link_is_absolute_on_the_athena_base_with_the_records_tip passes. It collects every href on the rendered page (it asserts there are 2) and checks that each starts with `{ATHENA_URL}/blob/{TIP}/records/work-items/`, so none is relative. open_proposals_are_read_from_the_records_branch_with_role_records also checks the real tip written by RecordsWriter.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a brief over about 120 words of prose is refused with an error, and a brief with no recommendation line is refused with an error. Expected 0% of newly refused readings outside the new renderer.
criteria.evidence: a_long_brief_and_a_brief_without_a_recommendation_are_refused passes. A 130-word title gives an error containing 'words of prose'; a 60-word title renders; a blank recommendation gives 'no recommendation'; a page holding the long brief returns Err. Athena's replay found 0 of 50 accepted readings newly refused, which matches the declared 0%.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a proposal with no evidence renders an explicit 'not recorded' statement, and a checkout without the records branch lists no proposals and the page says so rather than reporting success.
criteria.evidence: The first test asserts that brief b contains 'Evidence: not recorded.'. a_checkout_without_the_records_branch_says_so_and_lists_nothing passes. On a fresh git repo, read() returns NoRecordsBranch, and the page says 'The records branch is not in this checkout' and 'does not mean none are waiting', with no 'No proposals are waiting.' line and no article. A directory that is not a repository gives the same page.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: the rendered index contains a link to the decisions page, build() writes the decisions page next to index.html, and existing study page tests still pass unchanged.
criteria.evidence: the_index_links_to_the_decisions_page_and_build_writes_it_beside_the_index passes. It asserts `<a href="decisions.html">` is on the index, and that build() writes both index.html and decisions.html into out. All existing site:: tests and tests/site_page.rs (5 tests) pass, and the diff does not change them.

findings.summary: Criterion 4 is unmet: the two fixture proposals have the same source, so no test shows the brief's source line comes from the proposal.
findings.evidence: item() hard-codes the source for every fixture. The test asserts title, rung and evidence differ but never the source. A renderer that printed a fixed source would still pass. Fix: give each fixture its own source (for example Reference::job(...) on one) and assert each brief shows its own source line.

findings.summary: The published decisions page will always show the empty state, because the Pages workflow checks out only main, and the change does not mention this.
findings.evidence: pages.yml runs `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site` after a default actions/checkout, which does not fetch the records branch, so resolve_tip returns Missing. The page honestly says the branch is not in the checkout, so this is not a false success. But the goal stated in the reading (the owner reviews proposals on the published site) is not reached. Workflows are out of scope, so the fix (fetch the records branch in pages.yml) should be named and proposed, for example in the CHANGELOG entry.

findings.summary: The role-limit lookup is copied instead of shared.
findings.evidence: The filter-by-name / max_by_key(version) / highest_rung chain repeats athena-core work_decisions::role_limit. xtask cannot depend on athena-core, so a later change to one copy can silently leave the other behind. Simpler alternative: move role_limit into athena-data (beside may_change) and call it from both. That touches athena-core, which is out of scope here, so it is a follow-up.

findings.summary: One bad proposal or a diverged records branch stops the whole site build, including the unrelated index.html.
findings.evidence: build() calls decisions::page(root)? before writing anything. Any over-long proposal, malformed record (check_record_file error) or Diverged tip turns `xtask site` into an error, and the Pages deploy fails for the study page as well. Refusing a bad brief is what criterion 7 asks for, but tying the index page to it is a broader effect than requested.

findings.summary: The record path is rebuilt by hand rather than taken from the tree entry or from canonical_path.
findings.evidence: It repeats the format string in AnyRecord::canonical_path (athena-data records.rs:2897). It matches today, but it would drift if the layout changed.

findings.summary: The 120-word count leaves out the 'Record:' and 'Then run athena approve-work ...' lines.
findings.evidence: word_count covers only the title, rung, source, evidence and recommendation lines, so a brief that is actually shown can run somewhat over 120 words.

summary: The change adds docs/conventions/owner-style.md, a CHANGELOG entry, and xtask/src/decisions.rs. That module renders decisions.html next to index.html, with one brief per open Steward proposal. It reads work items, work decisions and role records from the records branch through athena-git, and parses them with check_record_file into AnyRecord. The recommendation uses the newest version of the raising role (matched by name), its highest rung, and may_change. This is the same rule athena-core's role_limit and in_limit apply. I ran `cargo test -p xtask` in this snapshot: all 61 unit tests and all integration suites passed, including the 8 new decisions tests and the new site test. Criteria 1–3 and 5–9 are met. Criterion 4 is not. It asks for two fixture proposals with different title, rung, source and evidence, but the item() fixture gives every proposal the same source, Reference::path("docs/design/x.md"). No test shows that the source line comes from the proposal, so a hard-coded source line would still pass. That one fixture gap fails the verdict. There are also smaller problems. The Pages workflow checks out only main, so the published decisions page will always say the records branch is missing; that is honest, but the change does not mention it. The role-limit lookup is copied rather than shared. One over-long or bad proposal stops the whole site build, including the unrelated index page. No files outside the deliverables list changed, and I found no personal data.
